name: deed_date_yymmdd_parse
why: Audited reality: raw DEED_DATE is a YYMMDD 2-digit-year string ('080122' = 2008-01-22). The Mover group (100 pts, highest weight) rides entirely on this parse; a silent century bug ('26' -> 1926) would zero every mover while ISO-based fixtures still pass. Pins the normalizer contract including the century pivot.

given.century_pivot_rule: YY <= current 2-digit year + 1 -> 2000s, else 1900s (current year 2026 -> pivot 27)

expect.end_to_end: scoring a parcel with raw DEED_DATE '260712' at as_of 2026-08-01 must yield mover 100 (20 days), identical to fixture 10's ISO input
expect.unparseable_behavior: null/malformed -> Mover skipped + confidence low (per R6.1), never a crash or a 1900s misparse
